Assistantships & Financial Aid
Graduate Teaching or Research Assistantships for graduate students may be available. Assistantships are provided based on the Department needs and applicant's credentials. Submission of an application does not guarantee that you will be offered an assistantship. Decisions regarding assistantships are made by the Graduate Committee after you have applied and been accepted into a program.
Additional information about assistantship opportunities and financial aid can be found here:
Graduate Student Appointments & Fellowships
